mechanism_summary: RouteProfile dispatch/weekday-routing sets spec.solverEndpoint to route-solvr.dispatch.svc:7000, a host that does not exist (the solver Service is route-solver), so route-optimizer's startup connectivity check against the endpoint it loaded from the profile fails, the container exits at startup, and kubelet restarts it in crash-loop backoff on both replicas.
decisive_evidence: Both dispatch/route-optimizer pods in CrashLoopBackOff with rising restart counts and 0/2 Ready; the optimizer log lines 'route-optimizer: profile weekday-routing: solverEndpoint=route-solvr.dispatch.svc:7000' and 'route-optimizer: solver route-solvr.dispatch.svc:7000 unreachable (RouteProfile weekday-routing spec.solverEndpoint); cannot plan routes, exiting'; the Deployment's ROUTE_PROFILE env naming weekday-routing and the mounted entrypoint reading /apis/fleet.northbound.io/v1/namespaces/dispatch/routeprofiles/<name>; routeprofile weekday-routing showing spec.solverEndpoint route-solvr.dispatch.svc:7000 while service/route-solver exists with ready endpoints and eta-publisher logs 'solver route-solver.dispatch.svc:7000 reachable'.
remediation_summary: Correct the profile, not the workload: kubectl patch routeprofile weekday-routing -n dispatch --type merge -p '{"spec":{"solverEndpoint":"route-solver.dispatch.svc:7000"}}'; on their next restart the optimizer pods read the corrected endpoint, pass the connectivity check and become Ready, with no change to deployment route-optimizer, service route-solver or the solver.
